title: Repeated crashes while editing scripts, signal 11
body:
### Tested versions

- Happens at random intervals in Godot Engine v4.4.beta4.mono.official.93d270693
- No other versions explicitly tested so far, but I don't think I had these issues in beta3

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta4.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7216) - AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads)

### Issue description

Ever since updating to beta4 I've had repeated editor crashes while editing my scripts. The game is not running while editing. I can have the editor sit idle for long periods without a crash happening. The only trends I've noticed it that is seems to happen while there are active errors in the script and/or while the editor is trying to give me intellisense for a function or similar. I don't know if it's related, it could just be a coincidence since these are common operations while typing. Aside from that I have no idea why the crash happens and I cannot force it by just typing.

Usually the editor crashes too fast for me to get the output in the log, but this time I got an alert that stalled it for me.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/429d11eb-847d-4cc0-ac60-8d0c8df4fda2)
"Instruktionen på 0x00007FFF5328D0CA refererade till minnet på 0XFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF. Minnet kunde inte vara read."
Rough translation: "The instruction at 0x00007FFF5328D0CA referred to memory at 0XFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF. The memory could not be read."

The full log output is as follows.
You'll see errors for the safe save function. I don't know why this happens, I'm only using Defender and I'm getting no errors about protected folder access. Could be unrelated to this issue. Unfortunately the stack trace at the end is probably not very useful.
